Senses.Explanation: The all-times locator: no special hour — what is asked of the learner is asked in every moment alike. Linji Yixuan tells the hall that whoever comes is not shortchanged — yet do not go sorting it out wrongly in any moment, for understanding or not understanding, it is all wrong, and let the whole world strip it off him; Huangbo Xiyun in the Wanling record says: in every moment, in walking, standing, sitting, lying, aim only at no-mind, with no sorting, no leaning, no lodging, drifting dumb-faced all day like a man no one knows; Huineng tells the verse-writer that supreme awakening must see its own mind at the word's fall, thought after thought in every moment, ten thousand things unblocked, one true and all true; the bloodline treatise of Bodhidharma answers the no-mind questioner: every act and every move, in every moment and every place, is your own original heart, your own original buddha. Guishan Lingyou's assembly instruction, kept in Dahui's treasury, sets the practitioner's heart plain and unfeigned — sight and hearing ordinary in every moment, eyes not shut, ears not stopped; Yunmen Wenyan on the road asks an old host how to make things out in every moment, gets the question thrown back — call what an every-moment? — and answers that Sakyamuni has already said it and Maitreya still does not know; Baichi Xingyuan turns Linji's old address over with Yuansou Xingduan's comment and rules his own: in every moment sort it out as it comes, not a hair wrong; Tianran Hanshi tells his assembly not to be carried around by false thoughts and dreamt-up notions in any moment, answering affairs without setting anything up.
